introduction_markdown:
**Cameroon General Certificate of Education Board - General Certificate of Education Examination. Food and Nutrition 2 (0540), ORDINARY LEVEL, June 2024. Duration: two and a half hours.**

Instructions to candidates: ANSWER ANY FOUR QUESTIONS.

You are reminded of the necessity of good English and orderly presentation of work. Tabulate wherever possible and use diagrams where appropriate.
incertitudes: Règle de choix : la page de garde imprime « ANSWER ANY FOUR QUESTIONS » (4 sur 6 questions imprimées), sans section et sans mention « only the first four will be marked ». `groupes` = ["PAPER 2"] et `regles_choix` = parmi 4 sur 6, identiques dans les 6 fichiers.

Sujet scanné (CamScanner) de 2 pages : page de garde et six questions sur une page ; lu en image, aucun schéma ni figure imprimé, donc `figures` vide dans tous les fichiers. Filigranes (gcerevision.com, Kawlo) ignorés. L'en-tête imprimé « Food &Nutrition 2 » est recopié en « Food and Nutrition 2 » dans l'introduction ; les petites fautes de frappe du sujet (« five(5) », « Bring out five (5) importance of  food and nutrition », « types of food service  . ») sont recopiées telles quelles.

Points : chaque question imprime « Total = (25 marks) » et les points imprimés des sous-questions totalisent bien 25 pour les six questions (Q1 : 3+5+6+6+5 ; Q2 : 4+6+10+5 ; Q3 : 10+5+5+5 ; Q4 : 4+6+2+3+5+5 ; Q5 : 2+7+4+6+6 ; Q6 : 5+5+5+5+5) : aucun écart. Les sous-parties (i), (ii) restent dans le texte de la sous-question (d), 4(c), 4(d), 5(a) ou 6(d), dont `points` est la somme imprimée.

Aucun corrigé officiel : les corrigés sont des réponses modèles rédigées, au nombre exact d'éléments demandé, avec quelques réponses acceptables supplémentaires entre parenthèses. Aucune composition chiffrée de plat ou d'aliment n'est avancée ; les seuls chiffres sont les valeurs énergétiques classiques de la question 3(b), recalculées avec Python.
Question 5(a)(ii) : le contenu d'une trousse de premiers secours varie selon les manuels ; sept éléments usuels sont donnés, les autres figurent entre parenthèses.

questions.enonce_markdown:
(i) Define First aid

(2 marks)

(ii) Outline seven (7) items found in a first aid kit.

(7 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**(i) First aid**

First aid is the **immediate help or treatment given to a person who is suddenly ill or injured, before a doctor or other medical help arrives**. Its aims are to save life, to prevent the condition from becoming worse and to help recovery.

**(ii) Seven items found in a first aid kit (1 mark each)**

1. **Adhesive plasters** of different sizes, to cover small cuts.
2. **Sterile gauze and dressings**, to cover and protect wounds.
3. **Bandages**, roller and triangular, to hold dressings in place and to support injured limbs.
4. **Cotton wool**, to clean the skin around a wound.
5. **Antiseptic liquid or cream**, to clean cuts and prevent infection.
6. **Scissors**, to cut dressings, bandages and plasters.
7. **Safety pins**, to fasten bandages.

(Other correct items: adhesive tape, disposable gloves, tweezers, a clinical thermometer, pain-relief tablets such as paracetamol, burn cream, eye wash, oral rehydration salts.)

questions.enonce_markdown:
State four (4) types of food service  .

(4 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
Four types of food service (1 mark each):

1. **Waiter (table) service** - the waiter brings the food to the customers seated at the table and serves it.
2. **Self-service (cafeteria)** - the customers take a tray and choose and carry their own food from a counter.
3. **Buffet service** - the dishes are arranged on a long table and the guests serve themselves, then eat standing or sitting.
4. **Counter service** - the customers order and are served at a counter, as in a snack bar or a fast-food restaurant.

(Other types: tray service, as in a hospital; trolley service; take-away service; family service, where the dishes are placed on the table and the diners help themselves.)

questions.enonce_markdown:
Enumerate six (6) qualities of a waiter.

(6 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
Six qualities of a good waiter (1 mark each):

1. **Clean and neat appearance** - a clean uniform, clean hands and nails, tidy hair and good personal hygiene.
2. **Politeness and a friendly manner** - he or she greets and speaks to the customers courteously.
3. **Good memory and attention** - he or she remembers the orders and notices what the customers need without being called.
4. **Honesty** - he or she gives the correct bill and the correct change.
5. **Speed and efficiency** - the customers are served quickly and without mistakes.
6. **Good knowledge of the menu** - he or she can describe the dishes and answer the customers' questions.

(Other correct qualities: punctuality; good health, free from infection; patience and tact; good communication; hard work; the ability to work in a team.)

questions.enonce_markdown:
Mention six (6) basic information found in an invitation.

(6 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
Six basic pieces of information found in an invitation (1 mark each):

1. **The name of the person (or people) who invites** - the host.
2. **The name of the person invited** - the guest.
3. **The occasion or purpose** - for example a wedding, a birthday or a graduation.
4. **The date** of the event.
5. **The time** at which the event begins (and sometimes ends).
6. **The place (venue)** where it will be held.

(Other correct points: the reply requested (RSVP) and a contact address or telephone number; the dress code; the programme of the event.)
